checks.name: budget_authority_did_not_drift_with_N
checks.note: world.budget_authority() rebinds all three in-memory authorities for each world and restores them in a finally block, so the observed values are recorded twice: while the world ran (must be 58600) and after exit (must be the frozen 29300). The stored module attributes are the post-exit figure.

comparability_note: N!=6 is a new config and a new world: config_hash and behaviour_sha256 both move, so the N=3 and N=12 on-time counts are NOT comparable with the archived 108/192 or 131/192 figures. The N=6 equality check (criterion 5) is the one comparison this stage licenses.
